description: This file defines the Subtotal class within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It implements a method to compute various statistical subtotals, supporting multiple functions like average, count, max, min, sum, etc., with handling for hidden rows and formula filtering.

classes.name: Subtotal
classes.description: A class providing static methods to calculate subtotals based on function type, with filtering for hidden rows and formulas.

methods.name: filterHiddenArgs
methods.description: Filters out arguments corresponding to hidden rows in the worksheet, based on cell references.

methods.name: filterFormulaArgs
methods.description: Filters out arguments corresponding to cells that contain SUBTOTAL or AGGREGATE formulas.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Main method to compute subtotal based on function type and arguments, supporting hidden row handling and formula filtering.
